header: Receive managed response notifications and updates in Microsoft Teams
content:
updates in Microsoft Teams
） Important
Defender Experts will have access to all messages posted on any channel in the created
Defender Experts team. To prevent Defender Experts from accessing messages in this
team, go to Apps in Teams then navigate to Manage your apps > Defender Experts >
Remove. This removal action can't be reversed.
3. Select Next to review your settings.
4. Select Submit. The step-by-step guide then completes the initial setup.
5. Select View readiness assessment to complete the necessary actions required to optimize
your security posture.
To turn on Teams notifications and chat after the initial setup, go to Settings > Defender
Experts > Teams.
Apart from onboarding service delivery, our expertise on the Microsoft Defender XDR product
suite enables Defender Experts for XDR to let you run a readiness assessment and help you get
the most out of your Microsoft security products.
The readiness assessment is based on the number of protected devices and identities in your
environment, and Defender Experts' policy recommendations. To view the assessment, in your
Microsoft Defender portal, go to Settings > Defender Experts then select Service status.
７ Note
To set up the Defender Experts Teams application, you must have either the Global
administrator or Security administrator role assigned, and a Microsoft Teams license.
